snippet.description:
Can you guess what this figure is doing with his hands?

This fascinating wall carving shows a kneeling figure interacting with a mysterious round object placed on a decorated stand. One hand appears to hold a long staff or symbol, while the other reaches toward the unusual object. The surrounding hieroglyphs add even more mystery to the scene.

Was this part of a religious ritual, a symbolic ceremony, or something with a meaning we don’t fully understand today?

Ancient Egyptian art often combined everyday actions with powerful religious symbolism.
.
.
.

Today, in this special podcast, we welcome Kareena Kapoor Khan. She is a popular Indian actress who has appeared in numerous Bollywood films. She comes from the famous Kapoor family in the Indian film industry and has established herself as one of the leading actresses of Bollywood.

In this episode, we will talk about the real Kareena Kapoor Khan and the secret behind her confident personality. We will talk about her life, her career, the famous Kapoor family, her size zero phase, her ambition towards her work, insecurities, difficulties, and much more. We will also talk about Saif Ali Khan and his never-ending legacy in Bollywood, Ranbir Kapoor, nepotism, and much more. 

This was an in-depth conversation with none other than Kareena Kapoor Khan. I hope you will enjoy this amazing conversation and please let me know your thoughts in the comments.

snippet.description:
AIR 48 Aniket Ranjan explains one of the biggest traps in UPSC preparation: constantly chasing new books, PDFs, crash courses and study material.

Our brain naturally gets attracted to new information. But UPSC often demands the opposite: repeat, revise, practice and trust your sources.

In this session, Aniket shares an important lesson from his UPSC journey: stop running after every new resource and start getting better at what you already have.
